claims.statement: Ed Smith (printed as 'EP SmiTH'), the Denver heavyweight, and his brother Paddy spent a few days with Tom Allen last week.

notes: The Denver visitor's first name is garbled in the OCR (EP SmiTH); 'Ed' comes from the earlier hint and is not confirmed by the text. 'Last week' is the week before 1893-01-01.
